scope: Actual compiled Svelte UI with explicitly mocked Tauri backend and provider facts. No native MCP/file/provider execution.

tests.name: Only detected profiles appear as providers; technical controls collapsed
Per-model and per-provider exposure changes actual generated harness config
Pause, exclusion and resume controls send scoped policies without onboarding wizard
Provider-reported context separated from unknown limits and tokenizer execution
Harness choice persists; new registry events update config without reload
Normal address navigation creates ordinary tab, not an exposed provider
Import only command/argv; strips credential env and does not start process
Explicit local-process trust plus disabled-by-default per-tool exposure
Per-call approval binds run/call; optional manual result insertion continues same run
Deny submits no approval; broader per-task tool permission is explicit advanced opt-in
Untrusted model/tool text escaped and compact viewport has no document overflow
No JavaScript runtime errors in new discovery/MCP screens
